current_role: U.S. Secretary of the Treasury (since January 2025)
summary: Scott Bessent spent most of 1991–2015 at George Soros's Soros Fund Management, latterly as chief investment officer, then founded the hedge fund Key Square Group with a $2 billion anchor investment from Soros. An economic adviser and fundraiser for Trump's 2024 campaign, he beat Howard Lutnick for the Treasury nomination and was confirmed 68–29 in January 2025; he has also served as acting IRS commissioner.

connections.name: Elon Musk
connections.description: Musk called Bessent the "business-as-usual" Treasury pick and backed Lutnick in November 2024; in April 2025 the two had a West Wing shouting match over who should run the IRS, which Bessent won.

connections.name: Howard Lutnick
connections.description: Lutnick campaigned openly against Bessent for the Treasury nomination in November 2024, with Musk's backing; Trump chose Bessent. As cabinet colleagues the two were later credited with persuading Trump to pause tariffs in April 2025.
